items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 return from hip after missing two games; Schefter and reports confirm expected to play, possibly on snap count.
items.why: Full practice progression and coach comments; no designation.
items.implication: WR1 volume returns but monitor early snaps/limits vs Eagles.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets rebound; Adams share may compress.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring.
items.implication: Elite WR1 back in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets vs weak Cowboys secondary.

items.implication: Jets backfield clears for backup volume.

items.text: Devonta Smith and Dallas Goedert listed OUT (with Hollywood Brown).
items.implication: Eagles pass game gutted vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining receivers/TEs and Barkley.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 3; missed practice.
items.implication: Vikings WR1 voided; massive target vacuum.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation he could have snaps limited, we'll see.
items.why: Return after multi-week absence; conditioning unknown.
items.implication: Start but fade slightly in DFS if limited early; still elite ceiling.
items.opportunity: Snap share and routes may ramp; Adams remains viable.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP data has Cowboys inflating opposing WR scoring by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.opportunity: High target share and red-zone in positive game script.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs. a borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson absence + home matchup vs weak secondary.
items.implication: WR2/3 with WR1 upside this week.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes, red-zone looks.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Will be without three of their most important players vs. Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.why: Key skill and defensive absences compound.
items.implication: Hurts/Eagles offense less efficient; fade pass catchers, lean Barkley.
items.opportunity: Barkley usage spike possible in run-heavy or checkdown script.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass work to Holani, fumbles, hurt (chest), Charbonnet back at practice. Still passes eye test long-term.
items.implication: IR seals short-term fade; long-term still viable post-return.
items.opportunity: Immediate beneficiaries in SEA backfield; stash Charbonnet.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: led RBs with 90% snaps last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
Jeremiyah Love LOVE: RB5 utilization, 26 touches topping W1+W2 combined; Giants allow 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
items.why: Explosive usage spike + soft run D + receiving role.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
